def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -1.0, dtype=float)
    valid = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    
    is_empty = (bins == 1.0)
    used_valid = valid & (~is_empty)
    empty_valid = valid & is_empty
    
    if np.any(used_valid):
        scores[used_valid] = np.exp(-(rem[used_valid] ** 2) * 4.0)
        
    if np.any(empty_valid):
        first_empty_idx = np.argmax(empty_valid)
        scores[first_empty_idx] = 0.15
        
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    valid = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    used_mask = valid & (bins < 1.0)
    empty_mask = valid & (bins == 1.0)
    if np.any(used_mask):
        scores[used_mask] = 1.0 - (rem[used_mask] / (bins[used_mask] + 1e-8))
    if np.any(empty_mask):
        first_empty = np.argmax(empty_mask)
        max_used_score = np.max(scores[used_mask]) if np.any(used_mask) else 0.0
        scores[first_empty] = max_used_score - 0.5
    return scores
